tasks.title: Add ArchiveDestination and MoveUnderArchive to afspec and rebuild MoveToArchive on them
steps: Write TS-12-1..TS-12-8 in afspec/lifecycle_test.go (use copyFixture and Transition on copies to make active/sealed/archived/superseded packages at <root>/NN_name; skip the read-only cases when os.Geteuid()==0) and confirm they fail

Add ArchiveDestination(specDir, root string) (string, error): compute filepath.Join(root,"archive",filepath.Base(specDir)); os.Lstat it; exists → &SaveError{Msg: "archive conflict: <path> already exists"}; any other stat error except IsNotExist (e.g. ENOTDIR) → *SaveError wrapping it; write nothing

Add MoveUnderArchive(specDir, root string) (string, error): LoadSpec and return a load failure unchanged (*LoadError); refuse a status other than archived/superseded with *LifecycleError; call ArchiveDestination and return its *SaveError; MkdirAll(<root>/archive, 0o755) and os.Rename, each failure a *SaveError; rewrite no file

Rebuild MoveToArchive(specDir, root): LoadSpec (wrap failure as *SaveError as today), call ArchiveDestination first and return its error before any write, Transition("archived", specDir) when not already archived (a superseded package included), then MoveUnderArchive; remove the copy-then-delete claim from the doc comment
Run the existing TestMoveToArchive unchanged and confirm it passes

tasks.title: Extend envelope Change, warning codes and ErrorInfo stage docs
steps: Write TS-12-55 (envelope), TS-12-56 (internal/cli, through Run.Warn and Run.Warnings) and TS-12-57 (go/parser import check over non-test envelope/*.go) and confirm they fail

Add Spec and Added string fields to envelope.Change (where spec 11 declares it) with `json:"spec,omitempty"`/`json:"added,omitempty"` and description tags; document the kinds status, moved and supersedes on the type
Add WarnTasksOpen = "tasks_open" and WarnSupersedesNotRecorded = "supersedes_not_recorded" in envelope/warn.go
Add aliases for both in internal/cli/warn.go and warnStages entries of "status" for each
Extend the ErrorInfo.Stage doc comment in envelope/error.go to list `status` and `archive`; keep envelope stdlib-only
done_when: envelope imports only the standard library

tasks.title: Add the --status and --by flags, usage errors and schema
steps: Write TS-12-10..TS-12-14 in cmd/speca tests (using Main against a temp spec root) and confirm they fail

Register --status and --by in cmd/speca/main.go options; extend options.validate: --status draft → usage error (message: no move leads back to draft; a package whose intent must change is superseded by a new one) with fix_hint {flag:"--status", valid:[active,sealed,superseded,archived]}; any other unknown value → same fix_hint

Usage errors (exit 2, stage usage, category usage, no result): superseded without --by; --by without --status superseded; --status with --task/--state, --validate or --list; --status with no positional input

Resolve --by with the shared internal/specpkg resolver (Locate) and prefix its refusals with `--by:`; refuse a --by resolving to the same directory as the input; the same-spec_id check after loading is added in task 4 (leave a clearly named hook)

Add a dispatch case in forms.go routing --status calls to a new status form function in cmd/speca/status.go (a minimal runStatus returning the correct shape for now, to be filled by later tasks; it must not write anything)
Update help text and flag descriptions, add `status` as an enum of the four values in the --schema enums, and regenerate cmd/speca/testdata/schema.golden.json with UPDATE_GOLDEN=1
done_when: --schema output equals the regenerated golden file

tasks.title: Status form core: load checks, move classification and lifecycle refusals
steps: Write TS-12-16, TS-12-18 and TS-12-19 (property: a pure refusalMessage(current,target) function checked over all ordered status pairs against an independent BFS) and confirm they fail

In cmd/speca/status.go implement the load step: LoadSpec of the input and of the --by package; failure → exit 1, stage load, category input, naming the directory (and --by for the replacing package); schema_version neither 0/absent nor 2 → same stage/category with a message that speca changes the state of format version 2 packages only; --force never overrides; refuse a --by package whose spec_id equals the input's as a usage error (stage usage)
Add the `underArchive` helper (filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(abs dir)) == "archive") and classify a move-only call (target==status, status archived or superseded, not under archive/)

For other calls where afspec.ValidTransition(status,target) is false, refuse at stage status, category lifecycle naming package, status and target: `already <status>` when equal, else the shortest allowed chain found by breadth-first search over ValidTransition (e.g. active → archived: seal it first (`speca <spec> --status sealed`), then archive it), none when no chain exists; fix_hint {flag:"--status", valid: allowed_status} only when allowed_status is non-empty

Establish the pre-write check pipeline as an ordered list of check functions (load, move, target checks, unknown keys, archive destination) returning a *cli.ErrorInfo, so later tasks add their checks in order; nil result and empty next on every refusal
Use the report builder of spec 10 for allowed_status

tasks.title: Activation and sealing with the unknown-key guard and the status write
steps: Write the ten tests (build active/sealed packages with Transition on fixture copies; add unknown keys to prd.md frontmatter or tasks.json) and confirm they fail

Activation checks: !afspec.HasIntent(PRDBody) → stage status/lifecycle, message telling the caller to add a `## Intent` section to prd.md, with `## Intent` on a line of its own, no --force override; Validate not valid → stage validate/invalid_spec naming failing rules, fix_hint.flag --force; under --force raise a high spec_invalid warning naming the rules

Sealing checks: intent drift (IntentHash set and body hash differs or no Intent) → stage status/lifecycle, no fix_hint, message says restore the activated intent or write a new package that supersedes this one; open tasks (pending/in_progress, optionals included) → stage status/lifecycle naming each task and state, fix_hint.flag --force; under --force raise a high tasks_open warning listing them

Unknown-key check (sealing, archiving, superseding, not move-only, not activation): from Validate entries with Check "unknown_field" refuse at stage status/lifecycle naming file and key, fix_hint.flag --force; under --force a high spec_invalid warning naming the dropped keys

Write step: set spec.UpdatedAt = time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339) then Transition(target, dir); read the package back with LoadSpec and build the success result (report-builder fields from spec 10, intent_hash, changes [{kind:status,from,to}]) with a seam (package-level function variables) for the library calls and read-back so later tasks can stub them
Map errors: *SaveError → exit 1 stage write/disk with the library message and no result; *LifecycleError/*IntentError → stage status/lifecycle

tasks.title: Archiving, move-only calls and the archive destination check
steps: Write the seven tests and confirm they fail

Add the archive destination check (last in the check order): for a move ending under archive/ from a package not under archive/, call afspec.ArchiveDestination(dir, filepath.Dir(dir)); a taken destination → stage archive, category disk, resumable false, naming the existing directory, no result

Archiving: not under archive/ → set updated_at, Transition("archived"), then MoveUnderArchive(dir, holding dir); already under archive/ → Transition only; move-only → MoveUnderArchive only with no file rewritten and updated_at unchanged

Build changes in write order: {kind:status,from,to} then {kind:moved,from,to} with display paths (internal/specpkg Display); read the package back with LoadSpec from the post-move directory so spec_dir is shown by the display rule
Assert the full check order in TS-12-15 (move/target checks before unknown keys before destination), also under --dry-run (dry-run behaviour completed in task 9)

tasks.title: Superseding with --by and the supersedes record
steps: Write TS-12-35..TS-12-39 (TS-12-39 as a property over 1-5 repeated calls, including resumed moves) and confirm they fail
Target check: the --by package must be draft, active or sealed, else stage status/lifecycle with fix_hint.flag --by; --force never overrides

Write sequence for a sealed package: set updated_at, Supersede(<R spec_id>, dir); then add the old spec_id to the end of R.Supersedes unless present, set R.UpdatedAt and Save; then MoveUnderArchive unless already under archive/

Save of R is attempted only when R is draft, or active without drift, and has no unknown_field errors; otherwise (or on Save failure) continue and raise a low supersedes_not_recorded warning naming R's directory, the id not recorded and the reason; --force never extends to R

Move-only call (status superseded, outside archive/, --by given): skip Supersede, add the id if still missing, then move; changes in order status, supersedes, moved omitting steps that did not run, with {kind:supersedes,spec:<R id>,added:<old id>}
Reuse the unknown-key check and destination check for the old package

tasks.title: Write failures, updated_at and the resumable archive failure
steps: Write the seven tests, using the seams from task 5 to stub the library call and the read-back (skip permission-based cases when uid is 0) and confirm they fail
Confirm updated_at is set (RFC 3339, UTC) on every package written, including the replacing package
Map write errors: *SaveError from Transition/Supersede/Save of the target → stage write/disk, library message, no result; *LifecycleError/*IntentError → stage status/lifecycle

MoveUnderArchive failure after a status write: exit 1, stage archive, category disk; message names the directory the package is in now, its new status and that running the same call again moves it; return a result (spec_dir at current location, new status, changes written so far) and next holding the same call against the current spec_dir with --by when superseding; summary says the status was written and the move was not
Implement Result.Resumable() bool in cmd/speca/result.go, true only for the archive-stage failure after a status write (retryable stays as RetryableFor gives)
Read-back failure after a successful write: stage load, category input, result present carrying changes
Verify the same call re-run is a move-only call changing nothing else

tasks.title: Dry run, summary sentences and next after a status call
steps: Write the six tests and confirm they fail

Implement --dry-run for the status form: run every check and warning as in a real call, skip every write and directory move, compute the post-write package in memory (Transition/Supersede result without saving; intent_hash from afspec.ComputeIntentHash), report result.dry_run true and the same changes; no file or modification time changes

Summaries: `speca: activated <name>`, `speca: sealed <name>`, `speca: archived <name>, moved to <display path>`, `speca: superseded <name> by <spec_id>, moved to <display path>`, `speca: moved <name> to <display path>`; suffix ` (dry run; nothing written)` under --dry-run

next after a call: after active, the claim `speca <spec_dir> --task N --state in_progress` for next_task when ready; after sealed, archived, superseded, move-only and refusals, nothing; under --dry-run, the same call without --dry-run keeping --force and --by
Confirm --force is accepted on the form without usage error (TS-12-9)

tasks.title: Report-form lifecycle suggestions and documentation
steps: Write TS-12-52, TS-12-53 and TS-12-54 (property over generated packages: run the suggested --status call and require exit 0) and confirm they fail

In the report form's next (cmd/speca/report.go), for a draft whose Validate is valid and body has HasIntent, add `speca <spec_dir> --status active` before any task suggestion; for an active package with no pending/in_progress task add `speca <spec_dir> --status sealed`; leave the --list form unchanged
Copy the checks' own conditions (including drift and unknown keys for sealing) so a suggestion never leads to a refusal; if drift or unknown keys exist, do not suggest

Update docs: docs/speca.md (--status form, checks, errors, warnings, --by, resuming), README.md and docs/architecture.md (lifecycle changes now have a command), docs/api.md (ArchiveDestination, MoveUnderArchive, Change fields, warning codes), afspec/README.md lifecycle table (add the two functions, update MoveToArchive row)
Run make doc and commit docs/generated/; run make lint and make test
